[EN] You've been a tremendous asset for us. Thank you. Kaleon is stalking several additional threats and could use your help.

He was heading east, on the upper tiers, last time I saw him.
[ES] Has sido un activo tremendo para nosotros. Gracias. Kaleon está acechando varias amenazas adicionales y podría usar tu ayuda.

Se dirigía al este, en los niveles superiores, la última vez que lo vi.

[EN] Welcome, ! You've earned quite the reputation within the Mysterium. Let's see what we can accomplish together!
[ES] ¡Bienvenido, ! Te has ganado una gran reputación dentro del Mysterium. ¡Veamos qué podemos lograr juntos!
